The '''Battle of Jhantoria''' was fought between the forces of the [[Kingdom of Cron|Xer's Empire]], led by [[Xim/Legends|Xim]], and the [[Livien League]], at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jhantoria]]. The battle ended in a decisive victory for Xim.

Following the retirement of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Xer VIII|Xer]] on [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]], his son Xim became the new ruler of Xer's Empire that included almost all the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]]. However, one power managed to stand against him: the [[Livien League]]. Xim immediately sent his forces to Jhantoria, where they smashed the Livien League. He moved to raze [[Desevro/Legends|Desevro]], but was persuaded not to by the planet's military ruler, [[Maslovar Tiatiov]]. Tiatiov took Xim on a tour of Desevro's fighting academies and showed Xim the efficiency of the planet's bureaucracy. Xim was so impressed that he spared the Desevars instead of making an example for opposing his father. With Desevro the fourth Throne, the Cluster was unified under one crown, Xer's empire became [[Xim's empire]].<ref name="Xim Week" />
